add_hook_to_module: add a ModelHook to a PyTorch module to intercept pre_forward and post_forward calls
remove_hook_from_module: remove the attached hook from a PyTorch module and restore its original forward method
attach_align_device_hook: attach an AlignDevicesHook to all submodules of a model for CPU offloading with a weights map
AlignDevicesHook: create an AlignDevicesHook to move a module to a specific execution device and offload parameters to CPU
CpuOffload: create a CpuOffload hook that moves a model to CPU and back to GPU during forward passes
